'''Christl Ann Donnelly''' (born 1967) is an [[epidemiology|epidemiologist]] who was appointed professor of applied statistics at the [[University of Oxford]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/all-people/professor-christl-donnelly/|title=Professor Christl Donnelly - Department of Statistics, University of Oxford|publisher=|access-date=22 February 2019}}</ref> and a [[fellow]] of [[St Peter's College, Oxford]]. She is also professor of statistical epidemiology at [[Imperial College London]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bdi.ox.ac.uk/Team/christl-donnelly|title=Christl Donnelly — Oxford Big Data Institute|website=Bdi.ox.ac.uk|access-date=22 February 2019}}</ref><ref name=imp>{{cite web|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160415141830/http://www.imperial.ac.uk/people/c.donnelly|archive-date=2016-04-15|url=http://www.imperial.ac.uk/people/c.donnelly|publisher=Imperial College London|location=London|title=Professor Christl Donnelly|author=|year=2016}}</ref><ref name=gs>{{Google scholar id}}</ref><ref name=epmc>{{EuropePMC}}</ref> She is associate director of the [[MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Governance|url=http://www.imperial.ac.uk/medicine/departments/school-public-health/infectious-disease-epidemiology/mrc-global-infectious-disease-analysis/about-us/governance/|access-date=2020-07-08|website=Imperial College London|language=en-GB}}</ref> Donnelly was head of the Department of Statistics, University of Oxford from 2022 to 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Christl Donnelly CBE FRS FMedSci FAcadMathSci |url=https://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/people/christl-donnelly |url-status=live |access-date=13 April 2026 |website=Department of Statistics, University of Oxford |publisher=University of Oxford}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=3 October 2022 |title=MPLS Division hosts welcome reception ahead of new academic year |url=https://www.mpls.ox.ac.uk/latest/news/mpls-division-hosts-welcome-reception-ahead-of-new-academic-year |website=MPLS}}</ref>

==Education==
Donnelly was educated at [[Oberlin College]] in Ohio, where she was awarded a [[Bachelor of Arts]] degree in 1988, and at [[Harvard University]] in Boston where, in 1992, she was awarded [[Master of Science]] (MSc) and [[Doctor of Science]] (SciD) degrees<ref name=dsc>{{cite thesis |degree=DSc |first=Christl Ann|last=Donnelly |title=The analysis of correlation in longitudinal and spatial data |publisher=Harvard University  |year=1992 |url=http://id.lib.harvard.edu/aleph/007854065/catalog  |oclc=84042479}}</ref> in [[biostatistics]]<ref name=whoswho/> supervised by [[Nan Laird]] and [[James H. Ware]].<ref name=mathgene/>

==Career and research==

===Awards and honours===
Donnelly [[List of Fellows of the Royal Society elected in 2016|was elected a Fellow of the Royal Society (FRS) in 2016]]<ref name=whoswho>{{Who's Who | author=Anon| title=Donnelly, Prof. Christl Ann | id = U4000451 | year = 2017 | doi =10.1093/ww/9780199540884.013.U4000451 | edition = online [[Oxford University Press]]|location=Oxford}}</ref><ref name=frs>{{cite web|author=Anon|year=2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160430080620/https://royalsociety.org/people/christl-donnelly-9192/|archive-date=2016-04-30|url=https://royalsociety.org/people/christl-donnelly-9192/|publisher=[[Royal Society]]|location=London|title=Professor Christl Donnelly FRS}} One or more of the preceding sentences incorporates text from the royalsociety.org website where: {{blockquote|"All text published under the heading 'Biography' on Fellow profile pages is available under [[Creative Commons license|Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License]]." --{{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150925220834/https://royalsociety.org/about-us/terms-conditions-policies/ |date=25 September 2015 |title=Royal Society Terms, conditions and policies }}}}</ref> and a [[Fellow of the Academy of Medical Sciences]] (FMedSci) in 2015.<ref name=fmedsci>{{cite web|author=Anon|year=2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160430081057/http://www.acmedsci.ac.uk/fellows/fellows-directory/ordinary-fellows/0009312-professor-christl-donnelly/|archive-date=2016-04-30|url=http://www.acmedsci.ac.uk/fellows/fellows-directory/ordinary-fellows/0009312-professor-christl-donnelly/|website=Acmedsci.ac.uk|location=London|title=Professor Christl Donnelly FMedSci|publisher=[[Academy of Medical Sciences, United Kingdom|Academy of Medical Sciences]]}}</ref> She was appointed [[Commander of the Order of the British Empire]] (CBE) in the [[2018 New Year Honours]].<ref name=cbe>{{cite web|url=https://www.thegazette.co.uk/notice/2937914|title=Christl DONNELLY Order of the British Empire|website=thegazette.co.uk|publisher=[[The London Gazette]]}}</ref>

In 2016 Donnelly won the [[Suffrage Science award]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.suffragescience.org/post/a-day-in-the-sun-for-bletchley-park-winners|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200919212216/https://www.suffragescience.org/post/a-day-in-the-sun-for-bletchley-park-winners|url-status=usurped|archive-date=19 September 2020|title=Maths and Computing 2016: A Day in the Sun for Bletchley Park Winners|first=Suffrage|last=Science|date=11 October 2016|website=suffragescience}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.suffragescience.org/post/maths-and-computing-2018-nomination-speeches|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200919230840/https://www.suffragescience.org/post/maths-and-computing-2018-nomination-speeches|url-status=usurped|archive-date=19 September 2020|title=Maths and Computing 2018: Nomination Speeches|first=Suffrage|last=Science|date=7 October 2018|website=suffragescience}}</ref> and in 2018 nominated {{ill|Ruth Keogh|qid=Q88406634}} for the award at the [[London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine]] (LSHTM).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lshtm.ac.uk/newsevents/news/2018/dr-ruth-keogh-receives-suffrage-science-award|title=Dr Ruth Keogh receives Suffrage Science award|website=LSHTM}}</ref>
